name: Manaka Nemu
source:
Nemu is widely considered to be the most beautiful girl in [url=https://vndb.org/c43551]Keisuke[/url]’s class, carrying the grace and poise of a sophisticated noble woman. Her demeanor and candor however, are condescending and intolerably insulting. Despite being classmates with Keisuke and [url=https://vndb.org/c7813]Kanae[/url], she has hardly ever interacted with them. She is sadistic and emotionally disgusting, spewing hateful discontent and encouraging irrational prejudgment with her every action. 

Even in this extreme situation that she found herself in, she still keeps her cool as her reaction is neither terror nor desperation, but amusement and delight. Nothing gives her more pleasure than the suffering of others, abusing the weak and breaking the powerful. Unfortunately for Keisuke, affection and torture are one and the same to her. When Nemu figures out about Keisuke’s hidden lusts, she'll gently start pressuring him to unleash them. One might surmise that she just loves being hated.

[Edited from erogereview, [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=141]MangaGamer[/url] and [url=https://eroderekko.wordpress.com/2011/10/31/euphoria-review/]belucre's euphoria review[/url]]
